paite: Ethiopia gam khen a lui gal a om, akhazap ging hawhaw gam tung agik hi.
heading: Pathian In Ethiopia Agawt Ding
english: Ah, the land of the rustling of wings, which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia;

paite: Tuipi ah, tui tung a tolh longte ah palaite sawlpa! Misawl hattakte aw, nam sang zehzoh mam hethot kiang ah, apawt tung ua kipan tutan a mi kihtakhuaitakte kiang ah, hoh un; nam in gam ahawm ua, apalpuk uhi, agam uh luite'n ahawmzak hi.
english: that sends ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of papyrus on the waters, saying, “Go, you swift messengers, to a nation tall and smooth, to a people awesome from their beginning onward, a nation that measures out and treads down, whose land the rivers divide!”

paite: Khovel a om tengteng leh lei a tengte aw, tangte a chiamtehna atakkhiak chiang un en un; pengkul amut chiang un ngaikhia un.
english: All you inhabitants of the world, and you dwellers on the earth, when a banner is lifted up on the mountains, look! When the trumpet is blown, listen!

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah hichi in achi, "Ka om kinken ding a, ka omna ah ka en gige ding a; nisat lai a kholum huthut bang leh buhlak kholum lai a daitui mei bang in," chi in.
english: For Yahweh said to me, “I will be still, and I will see in my dwelling place, like clear heat in sunshine, like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.”

paite: Grep loh hun ma a, apak abei a, apak grep puam a ahong om chiang in, ahiangnoute theikung attanna temta in a-attan sin ngal a, ahiang zam dalhte lamang in asattan lai ding hi.
english: For before the harvest, when the blossom is over, and the flower becomes a ripening grape, he will cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, and he will cut down and take away the spreading branches.

paite: Huaite tang a vasa sa ne chite a ding in, lei a sate a ding in nutsiat in a-om ding uh; huchi in vasa sa ne chite'n amaute nipi sung in ane ding ua, lei a sa tengteng in phalbi sung in ane ding uhi.
english: They will be left together for the ravenous birds of the mountains, and for the animals of the earth. The ravenous birds will summer on them, and all the animals of the earth will winter on them.

paite: Huai hun chiang in, sepaihte' TOUPA min omna mun, Zion tang ah, sepaihte' TOUPA kiang a piak ding in mi sang zehzoh nam, mam pekpokte'n, kipahman ahon tawi ding ua; nam ahih ua kipan kihtakhuaitak leh pau tuam nei ahi uhi. Huai nam in gam ahawm zel ua, apalpuk behlap lai ua, agam uh lah luite'n ahawmzak hi.
english: In that time, a present will be brought to Yahweh of Armies from a people tall and smooth, even from a people awesome from their beginning onward, a nation that measures out and treads down, whose land the rivers divide, to the place of the name of Yahweh of Armies, Mount Zion.
